mismatchAndAdjudication.cause: The first computation used the original circle center (3,-k) after reflection about the origin, rather than the reflected center.
mismatchAndAdjudication.correctedDerivation: The original center (3,-k) maps to (-3,k). The x-axis reflection of 3x+y=4 is 3x-y=4. Requiring the transformed circle center to lie on that line gives 3(-3)-k=4, so k=-13.
